entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Welcome. Will you be dining with us[n]today?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um, is it possible to have meals delivered[n]to my room?

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: You mean room service. Yes, that is[n]available only at this restaurant.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Aha! So, is there one room in particular[n]that always orders food delivery?

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Pardon me, but why are you asking me[n]this? I would like to see your boarding[n]passes if you don't mind.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Oh um, we've been asked to make[n]a delivery. It's to the president of an[n]IT company, I believe.

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Hm...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He apparently never leaves his room,[n]but Mr. Shido has given us direct orders[n]about this...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now then, this is a highly confidential[n]matter, so we must take it to him[n]ourselves.

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Ah, is that so? In that case, let me tell[n]you the way to his room.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well done, Queen! Just as I'd expect[n]from you!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Isn't this pretty close? I suppose[n]it's just upstairs.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems to be above the side deck[n]we passed through earlier. Is there[n]a way up somewhere?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Honestly, guys, I doubt this is gonna be[n]any use. If it were me, I'd never open[n]that door.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, that's no good! What are we[n]gonna do!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If only there was a way in besides[n]through the door...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: In any case, should we head back to the[n]side deck? Not that we'll be able to get[n]in from there...

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: I apologize for my prior rudeness.[n]I didn't know you were acquainted[n]with a VIP.

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: If you wouldn't mind, please offer our[n]wishes to see his honorable presence[n]in our humble restaurant.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This guy definitely doesn't leave his[n]room. We'll need to infiltrate his cabin[n]from elsewhere somehow...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: In any case, should we head back to the[n]side deck? Not that we'll be able to get[n]in from there...

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: This restaurant is for members only.

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Ah, I see you have a membership card.[n]Right this way, sir.

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: We also offer room service to our[n]VIP customers.

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Beyond this point is an elevator leading to[n]the upper floor of the passenger cabins.
